response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and infrastructure, which makes him significantly overqualified for a junior/mid-level entry-level role. While his technical breadth (TypeScript, Node.js, React/Ember, PostgreSQL-adjacent SQL, Kubernetes, AWS) technically covers the required and nice-to-have skills, the seniority mismatch is severe and he is likely to be under-challenged, over-priced, and a retention risk for an entry-level individual contributor position.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience spanning frontend, backend, and infrastructure
Strong TypeScript/Node.js and React/Ember.js background matching core tech stack
Demonstrated experience with Kubernetes, AWS-adjacent tooling, and clean architecture practices
concerns: Vastly overqualified in seniority for a junior/mid-level entry-level role
No direct experience with PostgreSQL, Nest.js, or LLM/OCR integrations specifically called out
Likely salary expectations and career trajectory mismatch, risking quick turnover or disengagement
